label: About
title: About Dark Arena Observatory
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 526 recent saved-signal files and 156 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @ZeroSuitCamus: In 2003 Wire Music festival was held in Saitama Super Arena because 40,000... and @geekbb: 纯前端项目，14×14 网格上随便放建筑、树、地形，总共 75 个手绘风素材。渲染用了分层缓存，不动的瓦片不重绘，只刷新正在操作的部分，静态画面几乎零开销。触屏和鼠标都能用，..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Dark Arena Observatory: Dark arena observatory, poster crop, browserless media shrine: a large soft amber-charcoal mass is cropped hard by left and top edges, bowed diagonally into a severe near-black right field. Two silver-white partial rings hover as headphone/optic arcs, glossy against compressed broadcast grain. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against bowed headphone/face pressure field, purple-white crescent rim, and cyan vertical diagnostic slit.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
